item.tib: dbal phur gsal ba'i sgron ma shes bya drug skor gyis man ngag
item.coloph: bla ma dam pa bru ston nam mkha' 'od zer gyi phyag dpe blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gtug pa'o
item.note: the colophon says that bru-ston nam-mkha' 'od-zer's personal copy was copied by blo-gros rgyal-mtshan. the former ought to refer to bru-zha nam-mkha' 'od-zer (late 13th century), younger brother of rgyal-ba g.yung-drung. it would then seem likely that blo-gros rgyal-mtshan here refers to 'a-zha blo-gros rgyal-mtshan.
